pure-announcement.rationale: This is Google's own launch PR for its ARD specification — partner logo wall, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform tie-in and get-started CTAs — and the catalog/registry sketch exists at promotional depth to serve the launch; the linked spec, not this post, is where the technique lives.

duplicate.rationale: No nearest concept covers cross-organization capability discovery; shadow-MCP detection and MCP governance address different problems.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The specification, schemas and quickstart are linked and independently checkable.

durability.rationale: A day-one spec announcement anchored in launch framing — partner lists and 'coming months' product availability — whose usefulness depends on adoption that has not happened yet.

actionability.rationale: Beyond publish-a-catalog pointers, it pitches the ecosystem rather than giving a reader anything concrete to build or decide with.

atomicity.rationale: One idea throughout: federated capability discovery via domain-hosted catalogs indexed by registries, with domain ownership as the trust root.
